doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Benny Mars, Italian bands, clarinetists and parade uniforms
summary: Recollections of the carnival parade leader Mars, Italian bandleaders like Gargano and Tosso, and the heavy uniforms with swappable name tags.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
